verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a fair question for a SaaS platform with an admin dashboard like WorkOS, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no in-product assistant. The official MCP server (workos-docs-15, workos-docs-44) lets external MCP-compatible agents act on the workspace, but that belongs to a different story (external agent access via MCP) and earns no credit for a built-in assistant.
